, biz20_charge_fee AS charge_fee , biz20_tax AS tax , biz20_note AS note , biz20_fix_yn AS fix_yn , biz20_appr_id AS appr_id , biz20_cont_corp_id AS cont_corp_id , biz20_tr_id AS tr_id , biz20_min_fee biz20_pre_occ_fee , 0 AS biz20_pre_real_charge_fee , biz20_occ_fee AS biz20_occ_fee , COALESCE(biz20_charge_fee,0) + COALESCE(biz20_tax,0) AS biz20_real_charge_fee FROM biz20_fee_charge WHERE + COALESCE(biz20_tax,0) AS biz20_pre_real_charge_fee , 0 AS biz20_occ_fee , 0 AS biz20_real_charge_fee FROM biz20_fee_charge WHERE biz20_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz20_charge_date = f_get_quarter_date(#{chargeDate}, '1') /* 전분기 */ ) t GROUP BY biz20_cont_corp_id, biz20_corp_id ) t2 INNER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = corp_id LEFT OUTER JOIN biz20_fee_charge ON ( mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz20_fee_charge (biz20_fee_charge_id, biz20_company_id, biz20_charge_date, biz20_corp_id, biz20_cont_corp_id, biz20_occ_fee, biz20_charge_fee, biz20_tax, biz20_note, biz20_target_yn, biz20_fix_yn) VALUES (#{r.feeChargeId}, #{companyId}, #{r.chargeDate}, #{r.corpId}, #{r.contCorpId}, #{r.occFee}, #{r.chargeFee}, #{r.tax}, #{r.note}, #{targetYn}, 'false')

mapper.select: SELECT stdDate FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN biz11_start_date < #{calcStartDate} THEN #{calcStartDate}::date ELSE biz11_start_date END as stdDate FROM biz11_cont_history WHERE biz11_cont_corp_id = #{contCorpId} AND #{calcStartDate} <= biz11_close_date AND #{calcCloseDate} >= biz11_start_date UNION SELECT biz13_first_start_date as stdDate FROM biz13_with_corp WHERE biz13_cont_corp_id = #{contCorpId} UNION SELECT biz13_last_close_date + 1 as stdDate FROM biz13_with_corp WHERE biz13_cont_corp_id = #{contCorpId} ) t WHERE stdDate IS NOT NULL AND stdDate BETWEEN #{calcStartDate} AND #{calcCloseDate} ORDER BY stdDate DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM biz22_fee_charge_calc WHERE biz22_cont_corp_id = #{contCorpId} AND biz22_charge_date = #{chargeDate} AND biz22_term_start_date > ( SELECT MAX(COALESCE(biz13_last_close_date, '9999-12-31')) FROM biz13_with_corp WHERE biz13_cont_corp_id = #{contCorpId} )
mapper.select: SELECT biz11_cont_status_cd AS cont_status_cd , biz12_min_fee_yn AS min_fee_yn , CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_min_fee_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN 0 ELSE biz12_manage_min_fee / (CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_fee_charge_type,'1') = '1' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END) END AS manage_min_fee , CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_min_fee_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN 0 ELSE biz12_adv_min_fee / (CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_fee_charge_type,'1') = '1' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END) END AS adv_min_fee , CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_min_fee_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN 0 ELSE biz12_discr_min_fee / (CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_fee_charge_type,'1') = '1' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END) END AS discr_min_fee , biz12_with_yn AS with_yn , CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_with_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN 0 ELSE biz12_with_fee / (CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz12_fee_charge_type,'1') = '1' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END) END AS with_fee FROM biz11_cont_history INNER JOIN biz12_fee_info ON biz12_cont_history_id = biz11_cont_history_id WHERE biz11_cont_corp_id = #{contCorpId} AND #{stdDate} BETWEEN biz11_start_date AND biz11_close_date ORDER BY biz11_reg_date DESC LIMIT 1
